## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --locked`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
- [ ] Updated documentation when behavior or scope changed.

For audio/device changes, describe the devices and signal checks used. For UI changes, attach a screenshot when useful.
